arStrings.szText: Belial's Apparitions are extensions of his deceitful nature. It's not enough for him to murder innocents, he needs them to believe.
The more the demons are seen, the more their power is believed, and the stronger Belial grows.
When he has enough power, Belial can draw all of Sanctuary into his own dominion, where only he decides what's real. This is the Realm of Lies.
